observations: Three photos show a large office printer wrapped in plastic, placed on a wooden shelf.
The printer has a black front panel with 'KONICA MINOLTA' and 'bizhub c3351' printed on it, visible in all three photos.
The top section is beige or cream-colored, with a sticker that says 'THE ONLINE TRAINING FOR YOUR bizhub' and a QR code.
The printer appears to be in a storage or warehouse setting, surrounded by other wrapped items and cardboard boxes.
No power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge is visible in any photo.
The printer is not shown in operation; no paper is being printed or fed.
The photos are watermarked with 'ECCENTRIC EQUIPMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly visible on the front panel in all three photos.

The photos show the printer's appearance, but there is no visual proof of color printing, A4 paper output, or all-in-one functionality. The claim is based on the seller's description, not visible evidence.

risks.risk: Printer may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and feeding paper correctly.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power cord, paper tray, or toner cartridge
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the printer.

risks.risk: Printer may be used or refurbished with hidden wear or damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the printer's internal components, paper tray, and control panel for signs of wear or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo showing all included accessories (power cord, paper tray, toner, etc.).
Close-up photos of the printer's internal components and control panel.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
